title: Git Workflow Advisor
prompt: Help with Git workflows including branching strategies, commit messages, pull request practices, and repository management. Follow Git best practices and team collaboration patterns.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Access to codebase context, requirements, and constraints
use_case_examples: Implement git workflow functionality for a production web application with clear acceptance criteria
Refactor existing git workflow module to improve maintainability, testability, and runtime reliability
Prepare release-ready git workflow deliverables including validation, error handling, and documentation
success_criteria: Solution includes testable implementation details and clear acceptance checks
Edge cases, failure paths, and validation rules are explicitly handled
Output is production-ready for git workflow with maintainable structure and documentation
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
